# @patina/materials

Procedural PBR material library. ESM source package, version 0.1.0.

## Public API

`presets`, `brushes`, `materialById`, `sampleMaterial`, `hash`, `noise`, `fbm`, `hexToRGB`, `rgbToHex`, `drawMaterialPreview`.

## Host contract

Numeric evaluation works in Node. Preview generation requires a Canvas 2D target. Presets are original procedural definitions.

No application-module dependency. See the root docs/ARCHITECTURE.md for data layout, lifetime and backend-selection contracts. These archives are local distribution packages, not a claim of npm publication.
